exposure: mid-urethral sling (MUS) operation prior to pregnancy
cohort: 94 women with a MUS operation prior to pregnancy and 330 women with a MUS operation but no subsequent pregnancy
finding: Pregnancy after MUS operation did not increase the odds of SUI re-procedure or re-visit compared to women who had MUS but did not have subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery was lower among women who had a MUS operation before pregnancy (57%) compared to deliveries before MUS (91%).
